main_text.head: LIBER SECVNDVS. DE REDEMTIONE CHRISTIANA, Ἀπολυτρωτικός.
CAPVT I. Transitio ad examen argumentorum aduersæ partis & eorundem in classes distributio.
main_text.p: IS quæ de summa controuersiæ præmittere visum fuit, breuiter explicatis, nunc ad argumenta, quibus aduersa pars pro defensione suæ sententiæ nititur, particulatim examinanda nos cōferamus: postmodum nostram quoque sententiam idoneis sacrarum literarum testimoniis & argumentis confirmaturi.
Pro omnibus igitur Adami posteris nullo penitus ex tota humani generis uni-

page.notes: The woodcut initial is "I" (the word reads "Is"); printed as "IS" with the large initial. Line-end catchword "uni-" is a hyphenated word continuing on the next page, so it is kept in the text. The Greek subtitle Ἀπολυτρωτικός is set in italic capitals as printed and is transcribed as close as the scan allows. Heading levels and caput numbers are inferred from the page structure. The top line reads "91" as printed page number.
